PROJECT: Pixel Office
PLAN FILE: /Users/ned/Desktop/Projects/pixel-office/PLAN.md

CONCEPT:
- Local Next.js web app
- Pixel art top-down office view
- Each 'worker' in the office = one Claude Code session (reads JSONL transcripts)
- Boss character = Ned (manages via UI rather than raw terminal)

APPROVAL SYSTEM (three-tier):
- LOW RISK (reads, grep, glob, ls, build/test commands) → auto-approve, worker proceeds
- MEDIUM RISK (file edits within project, git log) → auto-approve within project dir
- HIGH RISK (git push, delete files, install packages, network requests, paths outside project) → boss speech bubble, must approve via UI
- BONUS: Workers learn over time — first-time operations ask boss, subsequent identical operations auto-approve

REFERENCE PROJECTS:
- Pixel Agents (visual layer reference)
- Executive (hook-based session management reference)

APPROACH: Read JSONL transcripts for status (read-only), terminals still run separately, UI focuses terminal on click when worker needs input.

STATUS: Plan written. Not yet implemented.
